import ast,hashlib,json,os,stat,subprocess,tempfile,types,contextlib,importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
root=Path('/repo')
out={}
def literal(p,n):
 t=ast.parse(p.read_bytes())
 return next(ast.literal_eval(x.value) for x in t.body if isinstance(x,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(a,ast.Name) and a.id==n for a in x.targets))
inv=json.loads((root/'hermes-dev-v2/evidence/v232-fix/INVENTORY.json').read_bytes())
for p,v in inv['candidate_files'].items():
 b=(root/p).read_bytes()
 assert v==dict(git_blob=hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest(),sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()),p
pins=literal(root/'hermes-dev-v2/dvizhgitpush.py','PIN_PATHS')
assert pins==literal(root/'hermes-dev-v2/dvizhrelease.py','PIN_PATHS')==set(inv['protected_git_blob_inventory'])
assert all(inv['candidate_files'][p]['git_blob']==v for p,v in inv['protected_git_blob_inventory'].items())
names=sorted(set(literal(root/'hermes-dev-v2/owner_install.py','TARGETS').values())|{'owner_install.py'})
assert names==inv['payload_names']
digest=hashlib.sha256(b''.join(n.encode()+b'\0'+hashlib.sha256((root/'hermes-dev-v2'/n).read_bytes()).digest() for n in names)).hexdigest()
assert digest==inv['payload_sha256']
out['inventory']={'files':len(inv['candidate_files']),'pins':inv['protected_git_blob_inventory'],'payload_sha256':digest}
lines=(root/'.github/workflows/dvizh-hermes-autopilot-v2-tests.yml').read_text().splitlines()
blocks=[]
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
 if l=='        run: |':
  b=[]
  for v in lines[i+1:]:
   if v and not v.startswith('          '):break
   b.append(v[10:])
  if not any('PREPARE_ONLY' in v for v in b):blocks.append('\n'.join(b))
assert len(blocks)==3
out['workflow']=[]
for b in blocks:
 cp=subprocess.run(['/bin/bash','-c',b],capture_output=True,text=True)
 out['workflow'].append(dict(script=b,exit_code=cp.returncode,stderr=cp.stderr))
 assert cp.returncode==0
def module(n):
 spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(n,root/'hermes-dev-v2'/ (n+'.py'))
 m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m);return m
out['doctors']=[]
cases=['valid','missing','malformed','null','pins_list','base_number','pin_null','wrong_schema','missing_pin','duplicate','symlink','ancestor_symlink','hardlink','fifo','unsafe_mode','unsafe_uid','unsafe_gid','unsafe_ancestor','oversized','deep_json']
for name in ['dvizhgitpush','dvizhrelease']:
 for case in cases:
  m=module(name)
  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td,contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
   d=Path(td);trust=d/'trust';trust.mkdir();p=trust/'owner-approval.json'
   obj=dict(schema=1,version='2.3.2',base='a'*40,pins={n:'b'*40 for n in pins})
   if case=='pins_list':obj['pins']=sorted(pins)
   if case=='base_number':obj['base']=23
   if case=='pin_null':obj['pins'][next(iter(pins))]=None
   if case=='wrong_schema':obj['schema']=2
   if case=='missing_pin':obj['pins'].pop(next(iter(pins)))
   raw=json.dumps(obj).encode()
   if case=='malformed':raw=b'{"CANARY":'
   if case=='null':raw=b'null'
   if case=='duplicate':raw=raw[:-1]+b',"version":"CANARY"}'
   if case=='oversized':raw=b' '*65537
   if case=='deep_json':raw=b'['*2000+b'0'+b']'*2000
   p.write_bytes(raw);p.chmod(0o600)
   if case=='missing':p.unlink()
   if case=='symlink':p.rename(trust/'real');p.symlink_to(trust/'real')
   if case=='ancestor_symlink':
    (d/'link').symlink_to(trust);p=d/'link'/p.name
   if case=='hardlink':os.link(p,trust/'second')
   if case=='fifo':p.unlink();os.mkfifo(p)
   if case=='unsafe_mode':p.chmod(0o622)
   def snapshot():
    rows=[]
    for f in sorted(d.rglob('*')):
     st=f.lstat()
     content=os.readlink(f) if stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode) else hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) else None
     rows.append((str(f),st.st_mode,st.st_uid,st.st_gid,st.st_size,st.st_mtime_ns,content))
    return rows
   real=os.fstat
   def fs(fd):
    s=real(fd);directory=stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode)
    return types.SimpleNamespace(st_mode=(s.st_mode & ~0o022 if directory else s.st_mode)|(0o022 if directory and case=='unsafe_ancestor' else 0),st_uid=1000 if not directory and case=='unsafe_uid' else 0,st_gid=1000 if not directory and case=='unsafe_gid' else 0,st_nlink=s.st_nlink)
   stack.enter_context(patch.object(m,'OWNER_APPROVAL',p));stack.enter_context(patch.object(m.os,'fstat',side_effect=fs));stack.enter_context(patch.object(m,'require_root'))
   if name=='dvizhgitpush':
    k=d/'fake-key';k.write_text('PUBLIC FIXTURE ONLY')
    stack.enter_context(patch.object(m,'KEY',k));stack.enter_context(patch.object(m,'ssh_env',return_value={}))
    stack.enter_context(patch.object(m,'run',return_value=subprocess.CompletedProcess([],0,'b'*40,'CANARY')))
    auth=lambda:m.verify_local_pins(d,'a'*40,'a'*40)
   else:
    stack.enter_context(patch.object(m.shutil,'which',return_value='/fixture/tool'))
    stack.enter_context(patch.object(m,'APPROVAL_ROOT',d/'state'))
    stack.enter_context(patch.object(m,'source_tree',return_value={n:dict(type='blob',mode='100644',sha='b'*40) for n in pins}))
    stack.enter_context(patch.object(m,'api_json',return_value={'sha':'c'*40,'parents':[{'sha':'a'*40}]}))
    auth=lambda:m.verify_owner_history({'commit':'c'*40})
   before=snapshot()
   row=dict(module=name,case=case)
   try:auth();row['gate']='accepted'
   except Exception as e:row['gate']=type(e).__name__
   with patch.object(m,'owner_manifest',wraps=m.owner_manifest) as spy:
    try:
     result=m.doctor();row['doctor']=result
     assert result['owner_authorized']==(case=='valid') and result['ok']==(case=='valid')
     assert all(s not in json.dumps(result) for s in ['CANARY','a'*40,'"pins"'])
    except Exception as e:row['doctor_exception']=type(e).__name__
    assert spy.call_count==1
   assert before==snapshot()
   row['read_only']=True
   if True:
    assert row['gate']==('accepted' if case=='valid' else 'GateError'),row
    assert 'doctor_exception' not in row,row
   out['doctors'].append(row)

c=module('dvizhautopilot')
out['aggregation']=[]
with patch.object(c,'api_json',return_value={}),patch.object(Path,'is_file',return_value=True):
 for case in cases:
  pair=[r['doctor'] for r in out['doctors'] if r['case']==case]
  with patch.object(c,'sudo_json',side_effect=pair):
   answer=c.doctor();assert answer['ok']==(case=='valid')
   out['aggregation'].append({'case':case,'ok':answer['ok']})
out['other_readiness']=[]
for name in ['dvizhgitpush','dvizhrelease']:
 m=module(name)
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td,patch.object(m,'require_root'),patch.object(m,'owner_manifest',return_value={}):
  if name=='dvizhrelease':
   with patch.object(m,'APPROVAL_ROOT',Path(td)),patch.object(m.shutil,'which',return_value='/fixture/tool'):
    (Path(td)/'pending.json').write_text('PUBLIC FIXTURE')
    r=m.doctor();assert r['owner_authorized'] and not r['ok'] and r['pending']
    out['other_readiness'].append({'case':'pending_rollback','result':r})
    (Path(td)/'pending.json').unlink()
    with patch.object(m.shutil,'which',return_value=None):
     r=m.doctor();assert r['owner_authorized'] and not r['ok']
     out['other_readiness'].append({'case':'missing_tools','result':r})
  else:
   with patch.object(m,'KEY',Path(td)/'absent'):
    r=m.doctor();assert r['owner_authorized'] and not r['ok']
    out['other_readiness'].append({'case':'missing_key','result':r})
   k=Path(td)/'fixture';k.write_text('PUBLIC FIXTURE')
   with patch.object(m,'KEY',k),patch.object(m,'ssh_env',return_value={}),patch.object(m,'run',return_value=subprocess.CompletedProcess([],1,'CANARY','CANARY')):
    r=m.doctor();assert r['owner_authorized'] and not r['ok'] and 'CANARY' not in json.dumps(r)
    out['other_readiness'].append({'case':'transport_failure','result':r})
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
